title: How much a Twin Cities ride-hail operator's January 2027 winter guarantee will pay ($350 to every driver completing 40 trips in four weeks), when last winter's recruits come back in a wave that straddles the funding date
subdomain: retention-cohort-lifetime-value-modeling (a ride-hail platform's supply-side driver cohorts: last winter's recruits read as a returning cohort whose resurrection is under way at the forecast date, sized from the part already back at the timing earlier cohorts kept)
prompt_shape: a committed fund to the nearest $50,000 with the drivers expected to qualify, a table taking the 2025 and 2026 guarantees to net cost (what never reached a driver, the net cost, the drivers paid), a table of the onboarding pipeline by month of first application from June to October 2026 (people who applied, approved, first trip by the as-of), and a two-slide deck with each guarantee's steps from main run to net cost charted
